# Tech Fortress

> Tech Fortress is a Dubai-based managed cybersecurity and IT services provider serving businesses worldwide. We deliver managed detection and response, endpoint and email security, backup and data protection, and secure infrastructure — with 24/7 SOC monitoring.

## Contact
- Website: https://techfortress.tech

- Address: Office 1401, Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Downtown Dubai, UAE

## Security Services
- [Endpoint Security](https://techfortress.tech/endpointsecurity.dc): Layered protection for laptops, desktops, servers and mobile devices.
- [Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)](https://techfortress.tech/edr.dc): AI-guided behaviour-based detection that stops ransomware and zero-day attacks, with full forensics and single-click rollback.
- [Extended Detection & Response (XDR)](https://techfortress.tech/xdr.dc): Correlates signals across endpoint, email, identity and Microsoft 365 in one platform.
- [Managed Detection & Response (MDR)](https://techfortress.tech/mdr.dc): 24/7/365 SOC monitoring, threat hunting, response and recovery as a service.
- [Email Security](https://techfortress.tech/advancedemailsecurity.dc): Seven layers blocking phishing, spoofing, business email compromise, malware and zero-days.
- [Ransomware Protection](https://techfortress.tech/ransomwareprotection.dc): Behaviour-based ransomware defense with automatic rollback.
- [Network Security](https://techfortress.tech/networksecurity.dc): Firewall design, segmentation, access control and vulnerability scanning.
- [GenAI Protection](https://techfortress.tech/genaiprotection.dc): Visibility into AI tool usage and prevention of data leaking into GenAI prompts.
- [Security Awareness Training](https://techfortress.tech/securityawarenesstraining.dc): Phishing simulation and employee security training.

- [Cyber Frame](https://techfortress.tech/cyberframe.dc): Hyper-converged infrastructure with built-in backup and disaster recovery.
